officialSources.observation: Official Jimma City Administration page. It confirms the city administration and lists general municipal offices, but does not expose a cadastral office, parcel layer, map service, or parcel API.
Official Amharic Jimma Town Municipality page. It confirms the municipal site in the native-language route, but contains no public cadastral data or parcel service.

Official national ministry page describing the Urban Land Development and Management Bureau's land census, registration, and information responsibilities across cities. This is general national agency evidence, not a Jimma parcel service.

Official e-Land map route discovered in native-language results. The indexed description identifies Addis Ababa's Land Holding Registration and Information Agency; no Jimma coverage or public safe parcel response was exposed.
Official Jimma-hosted copy of Ethiopia's urban land lease proclamation. It provides legal context only and no Jimma parcel geometry or safe identity data.

requests.outcome: Web discovery fetched the official page successfully. It exposed municipal information and links, but no cadastral viewer, service configuration, geometry endpoint, schema, or CRS.
Web discovery fetched the native-language municipal page successfully. It exposed no parcel service or safe parcel fields.

Web discovery fetched the official ministry page successfully. The page described institutional responsibilities, including land census, registration, and information systems, but provided no Jimma-specific public geometry endpoint.
Official e-Land landing route was discoverable, but the viewer was not text-exposed by the research interface; no Jimma-specific coverage, public schema, CRS, or safe parcel response was obtained.

Official map route was opened for viewer/configuration inspection. It was Addis Ababa-focused in the indexed first-party description and did not yield a usable Jimma parcel request or bounded anonymous ID+geometry response.

Local request attempt failed before HTTP because the execution environment could not resolve jimma.gov.et (DNS error). This was recorded as an environment request failure, not evidence of source absence.

registryBasis: No local Jimma registry, cadastre office procedure, or Jimma parcel map/API was actually evidenced. The municipal site and national ministry page are custodial/context evidence only, so registryFound remains null.
